address: The night market in front of Telephone Organization of Thailand, Tha Wasukri, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13000, Thailand
bio: Culinary theatre meets a one-man dance party at this Bang Ian Night Market stall named after the chef’s home province of Sing Buri. It serves omelette with crispy mussels – watch him whip them up and top them off with bean sprouts without missing a beat; then enjoy the fruits of his labour....
